title: Mixed Conditionals / Masharti ya Mchanganyiko
bridge: Katika Kiswahili, masharti ya mchanganyiko hana sura yao wenyewe: tunatumia mchanganyiko wa nyakati za kisomi ambazo yanaweza kuelezea ujumbe wa zamani pamoja na matokeo ya sasa au masharti ya sasa pamoja na matokeo ya zamani. Katika Kiingereza, mchanganyiko huu unaendelea kwa namna isiyo badilika: protasis (if-clause) na apodosisi (main clause) hutumia nyakati za kisomi maalum ambazo hutoa nafasi kwa mtu anayezungumza Kiingereza kulingana na jinsi anavyoelewa. Kuna kinyongo kikubwa kwamba huwezi tafsiri masharti ya Kiswahili hadi Kiingereza kwa jinsi inayotokana; unapaswa kujua sura ya kila moja ya mchanganyiko wawili na kujua wakati wa kutumia.
rule: Masharti ya mchanganyiko huwa yanajenga mchanganyiko wa hali ya zamani na matokeo ya sasa (aina 3 + aina 2) au hali ya sasa na matokeo ya zamani (aina 2 + aina 3). Sura 1: If + past perfect, would + kisomi cha msingi (hali ya zamani, matokeo ya sasa). Mifano: If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now. Sura 2: If + simple past, would have + past participle (hali ya sasa, matokeo ya zamani). Mifano: If I were you, I would have told her the truth. Ujumbe: Katika masharti ya mchanganyiko, ni kawaida kutumia 'were' badala ya 'was' kwa watu wote katika hali ya sasa (If I were...). Pia, utaratibu wa vesi unaweza kubadilishwa bila kubadilisha maana, lakini koma hutumika tu wakati hali inapoanza.

concept_examples.text: If I had studied more, I would be more confident now.
concept_examples.translation: Ikiwa ningelikuwa nimejifunza zaidi, sasa ningekuwa na ushirika mkubwa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd ˈstʌdid mɔːr, aɪ wʊd biː mɔːr ˈkɑːnfɪdənt naʊ/

concept_examples.text: If she were more organized, she would have finished the project yesterday.
concept_examples.translation: Ikiwa yeye angekuwa mwanamuziki mzuri zaidi, angekuwa amemaliza kazi jana.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː wɜːr mɔːr ˈɔːrɡənaɪzd, ʃiː wʊd hæv ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə ˈprɒdʒekt ˈjestərdeɪ/

concept_examples.text: If I hadn't missed the flight, I wouldn't be stuck in this hotel.
concept_examples.translation: Ikiwa sikingekuwa nimepoteza barua, sikingekuwa katika taabu hili.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ ˈhædənt mɪst ðə flaɪt, aɪ ˈwʊdənt biː stʌk ɪn ðɪs hoʊˈtel/

concept_examples.text: If he were here, he would have solved the problem easily.
concept_examples.translation: Ikiwa yeye angekuwa hapa, angekuwa ameweka mikakati ya kuweka mwisho kwa tatizo hili.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf hiː wɜːr hɪr, hiː wʊd hæv sɑːlvd ðə ˈprɑːbləm ˈiːzəli/

common_error.wrong: If I would have known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct: If I had known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct_alt: Had I known, I would have told you.
common_error.explanation: Hii ni hitilafu ambayo inatokea mara nyingi kwa watu wanaozungumza Kiswahili kwa sababu katika Kiswahili husema 'Ikiwa ningelikuwa nimejua', lakini katika Kiingereza hali haionekani na 'would' kamwe. Katika protasis (if-clause) hutumia 'past perfect' bila 'would'. Ili kuiweka, kumbuka kwamba 'would' inatokea tu katika apodosisi (matokeo). Pia unaweza kutumia sura ya kinyume bila 'if' na kusema kisomi cha mwanzo: 'Had I known...'.

levels.label: Mixed Conditional Type 1: Past Condition, Present Result
levels.translation: Msharti wa Mchanganyiko wa Aina 1: Hali ya Zamani, Matokeo ya Sasa

examples.original: If I had taken that job, I would be living in Madrid now.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd ˈteɪkən ðæt dʒɒb, aɪ wʊd biː ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪn məˈdrɪd naʊ/
examples.translation: Ikiwa ningelikuwa nimeingia chuo, sasa ningekuwa na kazi njema zaidi.
examples.note: Hali ni ya zamani (had taken) na matokeo ni ya sasa (would be living). Katika Kiswahili hutumia subjunctive pluscuamperfecto katika hali na conditional simple katika matokeo.

examples.original: If we hadn't argued, we would still be friends.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː ˈhædənt ˈɑːrɡjuːd, wiː wʊd stɪl biː frendz/
examples.translation: Ikiwa hatukungekuwa na shida, bado tungekuwa marafiki.
examples.note: Kutumia 'bado' (still) ni kawaida katika aina hii ya msharti wa mchanganyiko ili kuweka nguvu kwamba matokeo yanendelea katika sasa.

levels.label: Mixed Conditional Type 2: Present Condition, Past Result
levels.translation: Msharti wa Mchanganyiko wa Aina 2: Hali ya Sasa, Matokeo ya Zamani

examples.original: If I were more careful, I wouldn't have made that mistake.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr mɔːr ˈkerfəl, aɪ ˈwʊdənt hæv meɪd ðæt mɪˈsteɪk/
examples.translation: Ikiwa ningekuwa mwanamuziki mzuri zaidi, sikingekuwa nimefanya hitilafu hiyo.
examples.note: Hali ni ya sasa (if I were) na matokeo ni ya zamani (wouldn't have made). Kumbuka kwamba tunatumia 'were' kwa watu wote katika hali, ijapokuwa ni isiyo rasmi.

examples.original: If she spoke English better, she would have understood the movie.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː spoʊk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈbetər, ʃiː wʊd hæv ˌʌndərˈstʊd ðə ˈmuːvi/
examples.translation: Ikiwa yeye angoja Kiingereza vizuri zaidi, angekuwa amelewa filamu.
examples.note: Tunatumia 'if + simple past' katika hali (sasa) na 'would have + past participle' katika matokeo (zamani). Katika Kiswahili, kisomi mawili huwa ni subjunctive/conditional.

levels.label: Inverted and Reduced Mixed Conditionals
levels.translation: Masharti ya Mchanganyiko ya Kinyume na ya Pumzuri

examples.original: Had I known about the meeting, I would be there now.
examples.phonetic: /hæd aɪ noʊn əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ, aɪ wʊd biː ðer naʊ/
examples.translation: Ikiwa ningelikuwa nimejua kuhusu mikusanyiko, sasa ningekuwa huko.
examples.note: Ukurasa wa kinyume bila 'if' ni zaidi ya kawaida na hutumika zaidi katika maudhui ya kusoma au ya masomo. Katika hali hii, hali ni ya zamani na matokeo ni ya sasa.

examples.original: Were I in your position, I would have accepted the offer.
examples.phonetic: /wɜːr aɪ ɪn jɔːr pəˈzɪʃən, aɪ wʊd hæv əkˈseptɪd ði ˈɒfər/
examples.translation: Ikiwa ningekuwa mahali pako, ningekubali malipo.
examples.note: Sura ya kinyume 'Were I...' ni sawa na 'If I were...' na hutumika ili kuweka usafiri wa kiingereza. Sura hii ni sawa na ukurasa wa kinyume na 'Had I...'.

examples.original: If you hadn't lied, we would trust you now.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf juː ˈhædənt laɪd, wiː wʊd trʌst juː naʊ/
examples.translation: Ikiwa hukungekuwa umewasha, sasa tungekuwa tunakutana na wewe.
examples.note: Mfano huu unaweka utumiaji mkubwa: kushikwa na matendo ya zamani na matokeo ya sasa. Kisomi 'trust' katika present simple baada ya 'would' ni sahihi kwa sababu inaelezea hali ya kawaida.

title: Advanced Passive Voice: Gerunds, Infinitives, and Modals / Sauti ya pasivi ya kiini: gerundizi, infinitivi na modali
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, sauti ya pasivi ina ufanisi zaidi: unaweza kuwa na 'must be done', 'being done', 'to be done', n.k. Hitilafu ya kawaida ni kufanya uhamishaji wa uhamasishaji wa Kihispania kwa harfia, kama 'debe ser hecho' badala ya 'has to be done'. Pia, katika Kiingereza mwanzo huondolewa mara nyingi (hakusemi 'by someone' ikiwa si muhimu), wakati wa Kihispania tunapenda kuweka.
rule: Katika Kiingereza, sauti ya pasivi ya kiini inundwa na fiili 'to be' katika nyakati tofauti, modali au mifumo ya kisimamu, inayofuata na sehemu ya kutoka. Kwa modali: modali + be + sehemu (mifano. 'must be done', 'can be seen'). Kwa infinitivi: to be + sehemu (mifano. 'to be considered'). Kwa gerundizi: being + sehemu (mifano. 'being watched'). Na fiili za modali za kamilifu: modali + have been + sehemu (mifano. 'should have been informed'). Pia kuna pasivi na preposition: 'This chair was sat on' (ingawa haikuweka). Jikinge na fiili ambazo hutoa pasivi (intransitive) na na kuondoa mwanzo: ikiwa si lazima, huondolewa. Katika Kihispania, pasivi ni zaidi ya kugumuza na inapendwa sauti ya kifuatano au 'se'.

concept_examples.text: The report must be submitted by Friday.
concept_examples.translation: Ripoti lazima ipelekee kwa ajili ya Ijumaa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈpɔːrt mʌst biː səbˈmɪtɪd baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/

concept_examples.text: She enjoys being photographed.
concept_examples.translation: Yeye anafurahia kuwa na picha zake.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪnˈdʒɔɪz ˈbiːɪŋ ˈfoʊtəɡræft/

concept_examples.text: The problem needs to be solved immediately.
concept_examples.translation: Mshindo unahitaji kufanywa mara moja.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɑːbləm niːdz tə biː sɒlvd ɪˈmiːdiətli/

concept_examples.text: The package could have been delivered yesterday.
concept_examples.translation: Pakoti lingekuwa linaweza kupeleka jana.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈpækɪdʒ kʊd hæv biːn dɪˈlɪvərd ˈjestərdeɪ/

common_error.wrong: The problem must be solved *by us* immediately. (cuando no es necesario el agente)
common_error.correct: The problem must be solved immediately.
common_error.correct_alt: The problem has to be solved immediately.
common_error.explanation: Wasemirani wanapendeza kuweka mwanzo 'by someone' kwa sababu katika Kihispania mara nyingi huongezwa 'por nosotros' au 'por alguien'. Katika Kiingereza, ikiwa mwanzo ni wazi au isipokuwa ni muhimu, huondolewa ili kuwa na utulivu. Badala nyingine ni 'has to be solved', ambayo ni zaidi ya kawaida. Epuka kuweka taarifa ambazo hazijawahi.

levels.label: Passive with Modals
levels.translation: Pasivi na modali

examples.original: The rules can be changed.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ruːlz kæn biː tʃeɪndʒd/
examples.translation: Kanuni zinaweza kubadilishwa.
examples.note: Tumia 'can be' kwa uwezo. Katika Kihispania mara nyingi tunatumia 'se pueden cambiar'.

examples.original: The application must be completed before noon.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən mʌst biː kəmˈpliːtɪd bɪˈfɔːr nuːn/
examples.translation: Ombi lazima ikamilike kabla ya adhuhuri.
examples.note: 'Must be' ina maana ya shughuli. Katika Kihispania tunatumia 'debe + infinitivo'.

examples.original: This issue should be addressed immediately.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈɪʃuː ʃʊd biː əˈdrest ɪˈmiːdiətli/
examples.translation: Mshindo huu unapaswa kufanywa mara moja.
examples.note: 'Should be' kwa ushauri. Jikinge na usemi wa 'should'.

examples.original: The meeting may be postponed if necessary.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ meɪ biː poʊstˈpoʊnd ɪf ˈnesəseri/
examples.translation: Mkutano unaweza kupandishwa ikiwa ni lazima.
examples.note: 'May be' kwa uwezo. Katika Kihispania ingekuwa 'puede ser'.

levels.label: Passive Gerunds and Infinitives
levels.translation: Gerundizi na infinitivi za pasivi

examples.original: He dislikes being told what to do.
examples.phonetic: /hiː dɪsˈlaɪks ˈbiːɪŋ toʊld wɒt tə duː/
examples.translation: Yeye hampendi kuwa na amri kufanywa.
examples.note: Katika Kihispania tunatumia 'que le digan', wakati wa Kiingereza hutumia gerundizi ya pasivi 'being told'.

examples.original: She is proud to be selected for the team.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪz praʊd tə biː sɪˈlektɪd fɔːr ðə tiːm/
examples.translation: Yeye anafurahia kuwa na uchaguzi wa kushiriki katika kundi.
examples.note: Infinitivi ya pasivi 'to be selected' ina maana kama 'ser seleccionada' katika Kihispania.

examples.original: The data needs to be analyzed carefully.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdeɪtə niːdz tə biː ˈænəlaɪzd ˈkerfəli/
examples.translation: Data inahitaji kufanywa kwa makini.
examples.note: 'Needs to be' + sehemu. Katika Kihispania pia tunasema 'necesita ser'.

examples.original: He admitted to being involved in the incident.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ədˈmɪtɪd tə ˈbiːɪŋ ɪnˈvɒlvd ɪn ðə ˈɪnsɪdənt/
examples.translation: Yeye aliiomba kuwa na uhusiano na tukio hilo.
examples.note: Gerundizi ya pasivi 'being involved' ina maana kama 'estar implicado' katika Kihispania.

levels.label: Passive with Perfect Modals and Reporting Verbs
levels.translation: Pasivi na modali ya kamilifu na fiili za ripoti

examples.original: The thief might have been caught by the police.
examples.phonetic: /ðə θiːf maɪt hæv biːn kɔːt baɪ ðə pəˈliːs/
examples.translation: Mlea angeweza kufikwa na polisi.
examples.note: Tumia 'might have been' ili kufikiria kuhusu zamani. Katika Kihispania: 'podría haber sido'.

examples.original: The documents should have been signed yesterday.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɒkjumənts ʃʊd hæv biːn saɪnd ˈjestərdeɪ/
examples.translation: Waraka walikuwa wanapaswa kuwepo jana.
examples.note: Inaonyesha ubinafsi kuhusu shughuli ambayo haikufanyika. Katika Kihispania: 'deberían haber sido'.

examples.original: The president is said to be considering new policies.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈprezɪdənt ɪz sed tə biː kənˈsɪdərɪŋ nuː ˈpɒləsiz/
examples.translation: Inasema kwamba rais anafikiria sera mpya.
examples.note: Mifumo ya fiili ya ripoti: 'is said to be' + gerundizi. Katika Kihispania tunatumia 'se dice que'.

examples.original: The lost city is believed to have been discovered in 2015.
examples.phonetic: /ðə lɒst ˈsɪti ɪz bɪˈliːvd tə hæv biːn dɪˈskʌvərd ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd ənd fɪfˈtiːn/
examples.translation: Inaaminiwa kwamba mji uliopotea ulikumbukwa mwaka 2015.
examples.note: Pasivi na 'be believed to + have been + sehemu' ili kutoa habari kuhusu matukio ya zamani.

title: Advanced Reported Speech / Mshtuko wa isiyo moja wa mawaidha
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, wakati tunapokwenda kwenye mshtuko wa isiyo moja, huwa huhifadhi kipindi cha kisababu kama neno linaloongezwa limepoa katika hali ya sasa, lakini katika Kiingereza ni lazima kutokea 'backshift' (kuondoka kwa muda) wakati neno linaloongezwa limepoa katika zamani: 'She says she is tired' vs. 'She said she was tired'. Pia, katika Kiingereza mabadiliko ya kipindi ni zaidi ya kawaida kuliko Katika Kihispania: 'will' huhubiriwa 'would', 'can' huhubiriwa 'could', na kipindi cha zamani huelekea nyuma (zamani rastari → zamani rastari). Kuna kinyonga kingine ambalo katika Kiingereza hautumiwi subjunctive katika vesi vya kutoa taarifa kama Katiki Kihispania ('Dijo que viniera' → 'He said to come' au 'He said that I should come'), na kwamba mifano ya muda na mahali huhubiriwa kwa ubora wa kina (leo → siku ile, hapa → pale).
rule:
Kwa ajili ya mshtuko wa isiyo moja wa mawaidha katika Kiingereza (mwanzo wa B2):
1. **Backshift (kuondoka kwa muda)**: Kama neno linaloongezwa limepoa katika zamani (said, told, asked), kipindi cha neno katika jambo la kutoa taarifa huelekea nyuma hatua moja: hali ya sasa rastari → zamani rastari; hali ya sasa ya kuendelea → zamani ya kuendelea; zamani rastari → zamani rastari; hali ya sasa ya kufikia → zamani rastari; will → would; can → could; may → might; must → had to (au must kama ni sharti la ujumla).
2. **Bila backshift**: Hakuna kuondoka kwa muda kama ujumbe bado ni kweli au ina maana wakati wa kusema (ingawa ni chochote): 'He said he is ill' (bado ni mgonjwa) au 'He said he was ill' (bado hauna maana).
3. **Mabadiliko ya majina na vitu vya kinywa**: Kubadilisha kulingana na mwangaza: 'I' → 'he/she', 'my' → 'his/her', n.k.
4. **Mabadiliko ya mifano ya muda na mahali**: leo → siku ile; jana → siku iliyopita / siku iliyopita; kesho → siku ijayo / siku inayofuata; hapa → pale; sasa → wakati ujao.
5. **Maswali ya kutoa taarifa**: Utaratibu huondolewa hadi kutoa taarifa na kutumia 'if/whether' kwa ndiyo/hapana, na neno la kutoa taarifa kwa maswali ya kufungua. Hautumiwi msaada 'do/does/did': 'Where does he live?' → 'She asked where he lived.'
6. **Amri na ombi**: Hutumiwa 'tell/ask + kitu + infinitive': 'He told me to close the door.' Hautumiwi 'that'.
7. **Mifano ya kisababu**: 'would', 'could', 'might', 'should', 'ought to' huhubiriwa. 'must' inaweza kubaki au kubadilishwa 'had to' kulingana na mazingira.

concept_examples.text: She said she had finished the report the day before.
concept_examples.translation: Alisema kwamba alikuwa amemaliza ripoti siku iliyopita.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː sed ʃiː hæd ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə rɪˈpɔːrt ðə deɪ bɪˈfɔːr/

concept_examples.text: He asked if I could help him with the project.
concept_examples.translation: Alipouliza kama alikuwa anaweza kusaidia katika mradi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː æskt ɪf aɪ kʊd hɛlp hɪm wɪð ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt/

concept_examples.text: They told us to wait outside.
concept_examples.translation: Tulioniwa kwamba tusubiri nje.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ toʊld ʌs tə weɪt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/

concept_examples.text: She warned that the meeting might be postponed.
concept_examples.translation: Alionyesha kwamba mikusanyiko ingeweza kupandishwa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː wɔːrnd ðæt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ maɪt biː poʊstˈpoʊnd/

common_error.wrong: She said me that she was tired.
common_error.correct: She told me that she was tired.
common_error.correct_alt: She said that she was tired.
common_error.explanation: Katika Kihispania, 'decir' hutumiwa na kitu cha kinywa (me dijo), lakini katika Kiingereza 'say' hauna kitu cha kinywa; hutumiwa 'tell' wakati unapojulikana kwa nani inayotolewa. Kwa hiyo, 'said me' ni batili; inapaswa kutumiwa 'told me' au 'said' bila ya kitu.

levels.label: Statements with Backshift
levels.translation: Ujumbe na kuondoka kwa muda

examples.original: Paul said he was going to London the following day.
examples.phonetic: /pɔːl sɛd hiː wɒz ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ˈlʌndən ðə ˈfɒləʊɪŋ deɪ/
examples.translation: Paul alisema kwamba alikuwa akienda London siku ijayo.
examples.note: Angalia kuondoka kwa muda: 'is going' → 'was going' na 'tomorrow' → 'the following day'.

examples.original: She mentioned she had already seen that film.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈmɛnʃənd ʃiː hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi siːn ðæt fɪlm/
examples.translation: Alisema kwamba tayari alikuwa amewahi kuona filamu hiyo.
examples.note: Hali ya sasa ya kufikia 'have seen' huelekea nyuma hadi zamani rastari 'had seen'.

examples.original: They claimed they would finish the project by Friday.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ kleɪmd ðeɪ wʊd ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/
examples.translation: Walisema kwamba walitamaliza mradi kwa ajili ya Ijumaa.
examples.note: 'Will' huhubiriwa 'would' katika mshtuko wa isiyo moja.

levels.label: Reported Questions
levels.translation: Maswali katika mshtuko wa isiyo moja

examples.original: She asked where the nearest bank was.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː æskt wɛə ðə ˈnɪərɪst bæŋk wɒz/
examples.translation: Alipouliza wapi benki iliyokaribifu.
examples.note: Katika maswali ya kutoa taarifa, utaratibu ni kutoa taarifa: 'was' mwisho, si 'was the bank'.

examples.original: He wondered if she had received his email.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ˈwʌndərd ɪf ʃiː hæd rɪˈsiːvd hɪz ˈiːmeɪl/
examples.translation: Alipitaja kama alikuwa amepokea barua yake.
examples.note: Kwa maswali ya ndiyo/hapana hutumiwa 'if' au 'whether'.

examples.original: They asked us why we hadn't called earlier.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ æskt ʌs waɪ wiː ˈhædnt kɔːld ˈɜːrliər/
examples.translation: Tulipouliwa kwa nini hatukuwahi kuwasiliana kabla.
examples.note: Swali la asili 'Why didn't you call?' huhubiriwa 'why we hadn't called'.

levels.label: Reported Commands, Requests and Suggestions
levels.translation: Amri, ombi na maoni katika mshtuko wa isiyo moja

examples.original: The teacher told us to stop talking.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈtiːtʃər toʊld ʌs tə stɒp ˈtɔːkɪŋ/
examples.translation: Mwalimu alituambia tusikie.
examples.note: Hutumiwa 'tell + kitu + infinitive' kwa amri.

examples.original: She asked me to open the window.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː æskt miː tə ˈəʊpən ðə ˈwɪndəʊ/
examples.translation: Aliniomba nifungue dirisha.
examples.note: Kwa ombi hutumiwa 'ask + kitu + infinitive'.

examples.original: He suggested going to the cinema.

title: Inversion for Emphasis / Ufunguzi wa Kushikilia
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, ili kushikilia tunatumia utangulizi au kuweka mawasiliano kwa uhuru zaidi ("Sijawahi kuona kitu kama hicho"). Lakini, katika Kiingereza, wakati maneno kama rarely, not only, never, na kadhaa yaliyomo mwanzo wa jamlani, ni lazima ubadilishaji wa mwadhibu na msaada (au fiili 'to be') kama katika maswali. Ubadilishaji huu si chochote: ikiwa hutumia, jina la kiingereza ni rasmi lakini si sahihi ya kiingereza cha kawaida. Hitilafu ya kawaida wa Kiingereza ni kushuka ubadilishaji kwa sababu katika Kiingereza hakuna mbinu huu ya kisintaki.
rule: Ubadilishaji wa kushikilia hutokea wakati wa laini au maelezo yenye maana ya kushikilia au kushikilia inawekwa mwanzo wa jamlani. Zaidi ya kawaida ni: never, rarely, seldom, hardly ever, not only, no sooner, little, under no circumstances, at no time, in no way. Mbinu ni: [Maelezo ya kushikilia/kushikilia] + msaada (do/does/did, have/has, will, can, etc.) + mwadhibu + fiili mkuu. Ikiwa hakuna msaada, 'do' inaongezwa katika halisi au 'did' katika zamani (isipo 'to be', inabadilishwa moja kwa moja). Na 'not only' utumika ubadilishaji katika klausi ya kwanza: "Not only did she sing, but she also danced". Na 'no sooner' utumika zamani za kamilifu: "No sooner had we arrived than it started raining". Hatua hii ni ya kawaida ya matumizi ya rasmi au ya kiandishi, lakini hutumika katika mazingira ya kijamii na ya kihistoria. Haukupaswi kutumika katika mazungumzo ya kawaida ya kila siku.

concept_examples.text: Not only did she finish the project, but she also presented it brilliantly.
concept_examples.translation: Hakupekwa tu mradi, bali pia alionyesha kwa kina.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈəʊnli dɪd ʃiː ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈprɒdʒekt bʌt ʃiː ˈɔːlsəʊ prɪˈzentɪd ɪt ˈbrɪliəntli/

concept_examples.text: Rarely do we see such dedication in our team.
concept_examples.translation: Mara nyingi hatutazama hivi karibu katika kundi letu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈreəli duː wiː siː sʌtʃ ˌdedɪˈkeɪʃn ɪn ˈaʊə tiːm/

concept_examples.text: Never have I encountered a more challenging problem.
concept_examples.translation: Sijawahi kupata tatizo kubwa zaidi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈnevə hæv aɪ ɪnˈkaʊntəd ə mɔː ˈtʃælɪndʒɪŋ ˈprɒbləm/

concept_examples.text: Under no circumstances should you disclose this information.
concept_examples.translation: Kati ya hali zote ushirikiane taarifa hili.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈʌndə nəʊ ˈsɜːkəmstænsɪz ʃʊd juː dɪsˈkləʊz ðɪs ˌɪnfəˈmeɪʃn/

common_error.wrong: Rarely we see such beautiful sunsets.
common_error.correct: Rarely do we see such beautiful sunsets.
common_error.correct_alt: We rarely see such beautiful sunsets.
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu huhudhuria kwa sababu katika Kiingereza "Mara nyingi hatutazama..." hujengwa bila ya msaada, na mwanafunzi huongea kwa kina. Katika Kiingereza, wakati wa laini ya kushikilia inaanza jamlani, ni lazima utumie ubadilishaji na msaada 'do' (katika halisi). Badiliko bila ya ubadilishaji ni kuweka laini baada ya mwadhibu ("We rarely see..."), ambayo ni njia ya kawaida zaidi katika kusema kila siku. Ili kuhakikisha hitilafu, kumbuka: ikiwa laini iko mwanzo, unapaswa kubadilisha; ikiwa hupaswi kubadilisha, weka laini katika sehemu nyingine.

levels.label: Basic Inversion with Negative Adverbs
levels.translation: Ubadilishaji wa msingi na maneno ya kushikilia

examples.original: Never have I been so happy.
examples.phonetic: /ˈnevə hæv aɪ biːn səʊ ˈhæpi/
examples.translation: Sijawahi kuwa na furaha hivi.
examples.note: Inatumika 'have' kama msaada kwa sababu halisi ya kamilifu inahitaji msaada. Katika Kiingereza, 'never' inaweza kuwa kabla ya fiili bila ya hitaji ya ubadilishaji.

examples.original: Hardly ever does he arrive on time.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhɑːdli ˈevə dʌz hiː əˈraɪv ɒn taɪm/
examples.translation: Mara nyingi hufika wakati.
examples.note: Angalia kwamba na 'he' (mwadhibu wa tatu) msaada ni 'does', si 'do'.

examples.original: Little did we know about the plan.
examples.phonetic: /ˈlɪtəl dɪd wiː nəʊ əˈbaʊt ðə plæn/
examples.translation: Kidogo tulijua kuhusu mpango.
examples.note: Laini 'little' na maana ya kushikilia (kidogo) pia inaleta ubadilishaji. Katika Kiingereza inasema 'kidogo tulijua' bila ya utaratibu wa kipekee.

levels.label: Inversion with 'Not Only' and 'No Sooner'
levels.translation: Ubadilishaji na 'Not Only' na 'No Sooner'

examples.original: Not only did they win the match, but they also broke the record.
examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈəʊnli dɪd ðeɪ wɪn ðə mætʃ bʌt ðeɪ ˈɔːlsəʊ brəʊk ðə ˈrekɔːd/
examples.translation: Hakupekwa tu mchezo, bali pia walivunja rekodi.
examples.note: Ubadilishaji huwa katika klausi ya kwanza na 'did'. Sehemu ya pili (lakini pia) hauna ubadilishaji.

examples.original: No sooner had the meeting started than the fire alarm went off.
examples.phonetic: /nəʊ ˈsuːnə hæd ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ ˈstɑːtɪd ðæn ðə ˈfaɪər əˈlɑːm went ɒf/

examples.note: Na 'no sooner' inatumika zamani za kamilifu (had + sehemu) na ubadilishaji. Katika Kiingereza unaweza kutumia 'asubuhi' au 'no well' bila ya mbinu ya kipekee.

examples.original: Not only is she intelligent, but she is also very creative.

examples.note: Na 'to be' ubadilishaji ni moja kwa moja: inaweka fiili kabla ya mwadhibu bila ya msaada 'do'.

levels.label: Advanced Inversion with Negative Prepositional Phrases
levels.translation: Ubadilishaji wa kiwango cha juu na maneno ya kushikilia ya kiwango cha juu

examples.original: Under no circumstances should you open that door.
examples.phonetic: /ˈʌndə nəʊ ˈsɜːkəmstænsɪz ʃʊd juː ˈəʊpən ðæt dɔː/
examples.translation: Kati ya hali zote ushuke mlango huu.
examples.note: Mbinu huu ni ya rasmi sana na hutumika katika tangazo, kanuni au maelezo. Katika Kiingereza inasema 'kati ya hali zote ushuke...' bila ya ubadilishaji.

examples.original: At no time did the manager admit his mistake.
examples.phonetic: /æt nəʊ taɪm dɪd ðə ˈmænɪdʒər ədˈmɪt hɪz mɪˈsteɪk/
examples.translation: Wakati wowote bosi hakakubali hitilafu yake.
examples.note: Maelezo 'at no time' inahitaji ubadilishaji na 'did' katika zamani. Katika Kiingereza na 'wakati wowote' ni zaidi ya kushughulikia.

examples.original: In no way can we accept such a proposal.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn nəʊ weɪ kæn wiː əkˈsept sʌtʃ ə prəˈpəʊzl/
examples.translation: Kwa njia wowote hatupaswi kubali takasa hii.
examples.note: Pia inaweza kutumika na fiili ya kiwango kama 'can', 'could', 'should'. Ubadilishaji hutumika na kiwanza.

examples.original: Seldom have I seen such a magnificent performance.
examples.phonetic: /ˈseldəm hæv aɪ siːn sʌtʃ ə mæɡˈnɪfɪsənt pəˈfɔːməns/
examples.translation: Mara nyingi sijawahi kuona utendaji wa kipekee hivi.
examples.note: 'Seldom' ni sawa na 'rarely' lakini ni zaidi ya rasmi. Katika Kiingereza hutumika 'mara nyingi' au 'rarely' bila ya kubadilisha utaratibu.

title: Cleft sentences (It is/was... that) / Jumla za kugawanywa
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, ili kuweka uzuri kwenye sehemu fulani, tunatumia mifumo kama 'It was John who did it' au 'It is here where I live'. Katika Kingereza, hii inabuniwa na 'it' + fisla 'to be' + sehemu iliyowekwa uzuri + 'that/who' + sehemu ingine ya jumla. Togorofi kubwa ni kwamba katika Kiingereza, jina la mwangaza 'it' ni lazima (haitowezi kushukuliwa), na kilele 'that' kinaweza kubadilishwa na 'who' kwa watu, lakini 'which' haitumiki katika hizi halua. Pia, utaratibu wa maneno ni ngumu zaidi kuliko Katabela, ambapo tunaweza kugeuza fisla kwa uhuru zaidi.
rule: Jumla za kugawanywa (cleft sentences) hutumika kuweka uzuri kwenye sehemu fulani ya jumla. Mifumo ya kawaida ni: 'It' + fisla 'to be' (katika halali au zamani) + sehemu unayotaka kuweka uzuri (jina, kilele, kiambishi cha muda, mahali, n.k.) + jina la mwangaza ('that', 'who', 'whom', 'whose') + sehemu ingine ya jumla. Kwa watu, unaweza kutumia 'who' (jina) au 'whom' (kilele, ingawa rasmi). Kwa vitu na mengine, daima 'that' (au 'which' katika usomi wa rasmi zaidi). Katika halali hutumika 'is', katika zamani 'was'. Haitumiki 'it's' katika zamani (ni batili), hutumika 'it was'. Sehemu iliyowekwa uzuri inaweza kuwa jina, jina la mwangaza, jina la kuanzia au hata jumla. Mfano: 'It was Maria who called me.' / 'It is the weekend that I enjoy the most.' / 'It was in Paris that we met.' / 'It is because of you that I came.' Pia kuna tofauti na 'what' (what-clauses): 'What I need is a coffee.' Katika hii, haitumika 'it' kama jina, bali 'what' mwanzoni. Tofauti nyingine: 'The reason why...', 'The thing that...', 'The person who...', lakini zaidi ni za 'it' na 'what'. Ufasaha: haitumika 'it' wakati uzuri umewekwa kwenye kitendo chake (hutumika mifumo ingine kama 'what...do'). Katika ukatili, hutumika 'It wasn't...' au 'It isn't...'.

common_error.wrong: Fue Juan que rompió la ventana.
common_error.correct: It was John who broke the window.
common_error.correct_alt: It was John that broke the window.
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu ya kawaida ni kuterجمةmsha tarakimu kutoka Katabela 'Fue Juan que...' na kushuka jina la mwangaza 'it' katika Kiingereza. Katika Kiingereza, mifumo huahitaji jina 'it' mwanzoni. Pia, katika Katabela tunatumia 'que' kwa watu na vitu, lakini katika Kiingereza kwa watu tunapenda 'who' (ingawa 'that' ni bora, 'who' ni asili zaidi). Pia, lazima utumbue kwamba fisla 'to be' inaendana na muda na mtu: 'is' katika halali, 'was' katika zamani, kamwe 'was' na 'it' katika halali (batili: 'It is was'). Ili kuiweka, jaribu kutoa jumla na 'it' + 'be' + sehemu iliyowekwa uzuri + 'who/that'.

levels.label: Cleft sentences with 'it' (persons and things)
levels.translation: Jumla za kugawanywa na 'it' (watu na vitu)

examples.original: It is my sister who knows the secret.

levels.translation: Kugawanywa na 'what' na tofauti nyingine

title: Nominalisation: Turning Verbs and Adjectives into Nouns / Kutoa jina: Kubadilisha Vitendo na Vifaa kuwa Majina
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, kutoa jina ni jambo la kawaida sana katika matumizi rasmi na ya kiakademi: 'the discovery of' inapendekezwa badala ya 'they discovered'. Akiwipo tofauti na Kiispania, ambapo mara nyingi hutumika kifaa kama jina (el descubrir), Kiingereza hutumia mwisho kama -tion, -ment, -ness. Heshima: si vitendo vyote vinavyo wa na jina lililo toka kwenye msingi wake, na utaratibu wa maneno huwa na mabadiliko: Katika Kiingereza, kina (au 'of') huja kabla ya jina, wakati Kiispania hutumia 'de' baada ya jina.
rule:
Kwa B2, shughulikia mifano haya:
1. Vitendo → majina na mwisho: -tion (inform → information), -ment (develop → development), -ance/-ence (perform → performance), -al (approve → approval), -ure (fail → failure).
2. Vifaa → majina: -ness (happy → happiness), -ity (active → activity), -th (strong → strength), -ce (important → importance).
3. Mizamo isiyotambaa: choose → choice, believe → belief, prove → proof, lose → loss.
4. Matumizi: Katika Kiingereza ya rasmi inapendekezwa 'the implementation of the plan' badala ya 'they implemented the plan'. Na 'make' + jina: 'make a decision' badala ya 'decide'.
5. Ufasaha: baadhi ya vitendo havibadiliki (change → change), na baadhi ya majina yana maana maalum (relation vs. relationship).

levels.translation: Mwisho wa kifaa hadi jina

examples.original: The invention of the internet changed communication.

levels.translation: Mwisho wa kifaa hadi jina

levels.translation: Kutoa jina katika matumizi ya rasmi

examples.note: Katika Kiingereza ya rasmi inapendekezwa 'implementation' badala ya 'they implemented'.

examples.original: There has been an increase in unemployment.
examples.phonetic: /ðɛr hæz biːn ən ˈɪnkriːs ɪn ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt/
examples.translation: Kuna uongezeko wa watu wasiotumika.
examples.note: Ujumla wa jina na 'there has been' + jina. Ijenga kusema 'unemployment has increased' katika mazingira ya rasmi sana.

examples.original: The failure of the talks led to conflict.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈfeɪljər əv ðə tɔːks lɛd tə ˈkɒnflɪkt/
examples.translation: Kushindwa kwa majaribio kuliongoza kwenye ugomvi.
examples.note: Kifaa kisichotambaa: fail → failure. Usiseme 'the failing'.

title: Advanced Modal Verbs: Would Have, Should Have, etc. / Vitendo vya kiingereza vya mawaidi: would have, should have, n.k.
bridge: Katika Kiswahili, tunatumia mifano kama 'angali', 'lazima' au 'kuweza' kuelezea mifano kama hayo. Lakini katika Kiingereza, hutumia vitendo vya mawaidi (would, should, could, might) pamoja na 'have' na kipaji cha mudhari. Togofu kubwa ni kwamba katika Kiingereza mawazo haya yanatumika kwa utaratibu tofauti kuliko Katika Kiswahili.
rule: Inatengenezwa na kilema (would, should, could, might, must) + 'have' + kipaji cha mudhari. Hutumika kuelezea mifano ya kuhusu matukio ya zamani (would have), mashauri ambayo hazikutekelezwa au makatazo (should have), fursa ambazo hazitokei (could have, might have), na maelezo kuhusu zamani (must have). Katika mifano ya kushindwa, 'not' hutumika baada ya kilema (should not have / shouldn't have). Katika maswali, mwadhi hutupwa (Would you have...?). Mikusanyiko ya kawaida: would've, should've, could've. Ujumbe: 'must have' haujumaliwi kutumika katika kuharibu mifano ya zamani (hutumika 'couldn't have' au 'was not allowed to').

concept_examples.text: I would have called you, but I lost your number.
concept_examples.translation: Ningekukuambia, lakini nilipoteza nambari yako.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd hæv kɔːld juː bʌt aɪ lɔːst jɔːr ˈnʌmbər/

concept_examples.text: You should have studied more for the exam.
concept_examples.translation: Ungali somesha zaidi kwa ajili ya mtihani.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd hæv ˈstʌdid mɔːr fɔːr ði ɪɡˈzæm/

concept_examples.text: She could have become a doctor, but she chose art.
concept_examples.translation: Alikuwa aweza kuwa daktari, lakini alichagua sanaa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː kʊd hæv bɪˈkʌm ə ˈdɒktər bʌt ʃiː tʃuːz ɑːrt/

concept_examples.text: They must have missed the train; they're not here yet.
concept_examples.translation: Wamepotea treni; bado hawajapokuja.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ mʌst hæv mɪst ðə treɪn ðeər nɒt hɪər jet/

common_error.wrong: I would have called you, but I losed your number.
common_error.correct: I would have called you, but I lost your number.
common_error.correct_alt: I would have called you, but I had lost your number.
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu hii inatokana na athari za Kiswahili, ambapo mara nyingi hutumia kipaji cha mudhari (nilipoteza). Katika Kiingereza, baada ya 'would have' hutumika kipaji cha mudhari (lost), ambalo ni sura isiyotawala. Kumbuka kwamba 'losed' haipo; unapaswa kuhifadhi vipaji vya isiyotawala. Pia, hakikisha kwamba kilema kikuu baada ya 'have' ni kipaji, si zamani.

levels.label: Would have for hypothetical past
levels.translation: Would have kwa ajili ya zamani ya kuhusiana

examples.original: If I had known, I would have come earlier.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd noʊn aɪ wʊd hæv kʌm ˈɜːrliər/
examples.translation: Ikiwa ningeliijua, ningelikuja mapema.
examples.note: Angalia matumizi ya zamani ya kamilifu katika sharti ('had known') na 'would have' katika matokeo.

examples.original: We would have won the game if the referee hadn't made that mistake.
examples.phonetic: /wiː wʊd hæv wʌn ðə ɡeɪm ɪf ðə ˌrefəˈriː ˈhædənt meɪd ðæt mɪˈsteɪk/
examples.translation: Tungalikuwa tumeishinda mchezo wakati mrefu wa kiwanja ikiwa hakizungapata hitilafu hiyo.
examples.note: Katika ukatili, hutumika 'hadn't' katika sharti na 'wouldn't have' kwa ajili ya matokeo ya kushindwa.

examples.original: I wouldn't have said that if I were you.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈwʊdənt hæv sed ðæt ɪf aɪ wɜːr juː/
examples.translation: Sisi siyingeliambia hivi ikiwa ningekuwa wewe.
examples.note: Ujenzi haukuwa kama Kiswahili; Katika Kiingereza hutumika 'wouldn't have + kipaji'.

levels.label: Should have and Could have for criticism or missed opportunities
levels.translation: Should have na could have kwa ajili ya makatazo au fursa zilizopotea

examples.original: You should have told me about the meeting.
examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd hæv toʊld miː əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/
examples.translation: Ungali niongeze kuhusu mkutano.
examples.note: Hutumika 'should have' kwa kuweka makatazo kwa ajili ya kitendo cha zamani au kuelezea hasira.

examples.original: He could have asked for help, but he didn't.
examples.phonetic: /hiː kʊd hæv æskt fɔːr hɛlp bʌt hiː ˈdɪdnt/
examples.translation: Alikuwa aweza komba msaada, lakini hakufanya hivyo.
examples.note: 'Could have' inaonyesha fursa ambayo haikutumiwa.

examples.original: She shouldn't have quit her job so quickly.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈʃʊdənt hæv kwɪt hɜːr dʒɒb soʊ ˈkwɪkli/
examples.translation: Hakuwa anapaswa kushuka kazini wake haraka sana.
examples.note: Sura ya kushindwa 'shouldn't have' hutumika kuweka kwamba kitendo cha zamani kilikuwa hitilafu.

levels.label: Might have and Must have for possibility and deduction
levels.translation: Might have na must have kwa ajili ya uwezo na maelezo

examples.original: The keys might have fallen out of your pocket.
examples.phonetic: /ðə kiːz maɪt hæv ˈfɔːlən aʊt əv jɔːr ˈpɒkɪt/
examples.translation: Nyuki mengi mengelianguka kwenye mfuko wako.
examples.note: 'Might have' inaonyesha uwezo wa zamani, si uhakika.

examples.original: She must have been very tired after the trip.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː mʌst hæv bɪn ˈveri ˈtaɪərd ˈɑːftər ðə trɪp/
examples.translation: Alipasa kuwa amechoka sana baada ya safari.
examples.note: 'Must have' inaonyesha maelezo ya kina kuhusu zamani.

examples.original: They couldn't have known about the party.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈkʊdnt hæv noʊn əˈbaʊt ðə ˈpɑːrti/
examples.translation: Hawakuweza kujua kuhusu pawake.
examples.note: Kwa kushindwa maelezo, hutumika 'couldn't have' badala ya 'mustn't have'.

translations.sw: Vitendo vya kiingereza vya mawaidi: would have, should have, n.k.

title: Participle Clauses / Vifunguo vya Participle
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, tunatumia vifunguo vya participle (halisi au kilichopita) kuweka badala ya jumla nzima inayofuata na kutoa sauti zaidi ya rasmi na zaidi ya kushtaka. Kuna mshangao mkubwa kwamba katika Kiingereza mwadilishi wa jumla mkuu lazima awe mmoja na mwadilishi wa fungu la participle; ikiwa hapana, hutokea hitilafu inaitwa 'participle inayodondoka' inayotosha mbaya. Pia, Kiingereza ina mikakati zaidi kuhusu matumizi ya participle halisi ('walking down the street, I saw...') kuliko Kispanishi, ambayo mara nyingi inaacha matumizi ya gerund ('caminando por la calle, vi...').
rule: Vifunguo vya participle hutoa kwa kutumia participle halisi (-ing) au participle kilichopita (-ed au sura isiyotawala). Hutumika kutoa muda (wakati, baada ya), sababu (kwa sababu, kwa kuwa), hali (ikiwa), au kubali (hata ingawa). Fungu la participle mara nyingi linapohea mwanzo wa jumla au baada ya mwadilishi, na mwadilishi wa fungu mkuu lazima awe mmoja na mwadilishi wa participle. Kwa matendo yaliyotokea kabla ya mkuu, hutumika 'having + participle kilichopita' (mifano, 'Having finished my homework, I went out'). Katika sauti ya pasivi hutumika 'being + participle kilichopita' (mifano, 'Being late, I missed the bus'). Pia, yanaweza kutumika baada ya majina kuweka badala ya jumla za ki-relative (mifano, 'the man sitting there' = 'the man who is sitting there'). Hawatumiki na wadilishi tofauti; katika hali hiyo, lazima uhariri tena na kutumia mfunguo (while, because, n.k.) na mwadilishi wa wazi.

concept_examples.text: Walking down the street, I saw an old friend.
concept_examples.translation: Nikiwa nikishuka njiani, niliwona rafiki yangu wa zamani.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈwɔːkɪŋ daʊn ðə striːt, aɪ sɔː ən əʊld frend/

concept_examples.text: Having finished her work, she went home.
concept_examples.translation: Baada ya kufanya kazi yake, alirudi nyumbani.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈhævɪŋ ˈfɪnɪʃt hɜː wɜːk, ʃiː went həʊm/

concept_examples.text: The man sitting over there is my boss.
concept_examples.translation: Mtu aliyeketi huko ni bosi yangu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə mæn ˈsɪtɪŋ ˈəʊvə ðeə ɪz maɪ bɒs/

concept_examples.text: Being tired, I decided to go to bed early.
concept_examples.translation: Kwa kuwa nilikuwa na chini, niliamua kulala mapema.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈbiːɪŋ ˈtaɪəd, aɪ dɪˈsaɪdɪd tə ɡəʊ tə bed ˈɜːli/

common_error.wrong: Walking down the street, the church was seen.
common_error.correct: Walking down the street, I saw the church.
common_error.correct_alt: While I was walking down the street, I saw the church.
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu ni 'participle inayodondoka': fungu la 'walking down the street' hauna mwadilishi mmoja na jumla mkuu ('the church'). Katika Kispanishi, mara nyingi hii inaeleweka au hutumika pasivi, lakini katika Kiingereza ni batili. Ili kuivuta, hakikisha kwamba mwadilishi wa fungu mkuu ndiye anayefanya kitendo cha participle. Ikiwa siwezi, hariri tena na kutumia mfunguo na mwadilishi wa wazi.

levels.label: Present Participle Clauses
levels.translation: Vifunguo vya Participle Halisi

examples.original: Feeling hungry, I made a sandwich.
examples.phonetic: /ˈfiːlɪŋ ˈhʌŋɡri, aɪ meɪd ə ˈsænwɪdʒ/
examples.translation: Kwa kuwa nilikuwa na njaa, nilifanya sandwich.
examples.note: Participle halisi (-ing) hutumika kutoa sababu au muda wa pamoja. Katika Kispanishi, inaweza kutafsiriwa na gerund au na 'como' + kibali.

examples.original: She left the room crying.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː left ðə ruːm ˈkraɪɪŋ/
examples.translation: Aliondoka chumba akililia.
examples.note: Wakati participle inapohea baada ya kibali mkuu, hutumika kutoa njia au kuwepo pamoja. Hakikisha: katika Kiingereza, 'she left crying' hautumiki katika maana kwamba alikuwa akililia kabla; ni pamoja.

examples.original: While waiting for the bus, I read a book.
examples.phonetic: /waɪl ˈweɪtɪŋ fə ðə bʌs, aɪ red ə bʊk/
examples.translation: Nikiwa nikingoja basi, nilisoma kitabu.
examples.note: Unaweza kutumia 'while' + participle kutoa kushtaki zaidi kuhusu muda wa pamoja. Bila 'while' pia ni sahihi, lakini 'while' hutoa ufanisi wa zaidi kuhusu mshirika wa muda.

levels.label: Past Participle Clauses
levels.translation: Vifunguo vya Participle Kilichopita

examples.original: Frightened by the noise, the cat hid under the bed.
examples.phonetic: /ˈfraɪtnd baɪ ðə nɔɪz, ðə kæt hɪd ˈʌndə ðə bed/
examples.translation: Kwa kuwa alikuwa na hofu kwa sababu ya sauti, paka alijikinga chini ya kitanda.
examples.note: Participle kilichopita hutumika na maana ya pasivi au hali. Hapa 'frightened' ni sifa ya participle inayotoa hali ya mwadilishi.

examples.original: Given more time, I could finish the project.
examples.phonetic: /ˈɡɪvn mɔː taɪm, aɪ kʊd ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈprɒdʒekt/
examples.translation: Ikiwa ningepata muda zaidi, ningeweza kufanya kazi hii.
examples.note: Hutuma hali (ikiwa + pasivi). Katika Kispanishi, hutumika 'si' + subjunctive au 'dado más tiempo'.

examples.original: The window broken in the storm has been repaired.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪndəʊ ˈbrəʊkən ɪn ðə stɔːm hæz biːn rɪˈpeəd/
examples.translation: Dirisha lililovunjika katika mvua limehaririwa.
examples.note: Kama mabadilishaji wa jina, participle kilichopita huwa badala ya jumla za ki-relative za pasivi.

levels.label: Perfect Participle Clauses
levels.translation: Vifunguo vya Participle Kamilifu

examples.original: Having missed the train, we had to take a taxi.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhævɪŋ mɪst ðə treɪn, wiː hæd tə teɪk ə ˈtæksi/
examples.translation: Baada ya kupotea treni, tulitakiwa kutumia taksi.
examples.note: Tumia 'having + participle kilichopita' kwa matendo yaliyotokea kabla ya mkuu. Katika Kispanishi, hutumika 'habiendo perdido' au 'como perdimos'.

examples.original: Not having studied enough, she failed the exam.
examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈhævɪŋ ˈstʌdɪd ɪˈnʌf, ʃiː feɪld ði ɪɡˈzæm/
examples.translation: Kwa sababu hakuja kusoma kwa kutosha, alisquiza imtihani.
examples.note: Sura ya kiburi hutoa na 'not' kabla ya 'having'. Katika Kispanishi, hutumika 'no habiendo' au 'como no estudió'.

examples.original: Having been warned about the storm, they stayed home.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhævɪŋ biːn wɔːnd əˈbaʊt ðə stɔːm, ðeɪ steɪd həʊm/
examples.translation: Baada ya kuwashirikiwa kuhusu mvua, walikaa nyumbani.
examples.note: Sura ya pasivi kamilifu ni 'having been + participle kilichopita'. Ni rasmi na hutumika katika makala au maonyesho.

title: Subjunctive Rahisi / Subjuntivo formal (ni lazima kwamba yawe...)
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, subjunctive ni njia ya kusema ambayo haipo sana katika lugha ya kila siku na hutoa tu katika mazingira ya rasmi au ya akademiki, hasa baada ya maneno kama 'ni lazima kwamba...', 'ninaahitaji kwamba...' au 'daktari aliongeza kwamba...'. Tofauti na Kiispania, ambapo subjunctive ina mifano mbalimbali, Kiingereza ina tu mfano mmoja wa subjunctive, hasa katika verb 'be' (I be, you be, he be). Wengi wa washiriki wa Kiispania hutoa kutumia indicative ('he is') kwa sababu ni kawaida katika Kiingereza ya kila siku, lakini katika mazingira ya rasmi, subjunctive ni lazima.
rule: Subjunctive rahisi hutumika baada ya maneno ambayo huyakilisha uhiti, ushirika, ombi, au maana. Mifano ya maneno haya ni 'demand', 'insist', 'recommend', 'suggest', 'ask', 'require', na nyinginezo kama 'essential', 'important', 'necessary', 'vital', 'crucial', au jina kama 'requirement', 'suggestion'. Tofauti na Kiispania, ambapo subjunctive ina mifano mbalimbali, Kiingereza ina tu mfano mmoja wa subjunctive. Katika mazingira ya kawaida, washiriki wa asili hutoa kutumia indicative (he goes, it is), lakini katika imtihan za rasmi kama FCE au CAE, na katika kuandika ya akademiki, subjunctive ni bora zaidi. Pia ni kawaida kuweka 'should' (It is essential that he should be), lakini ni zaidi ya Uingereza na ya rasmi. Subjunctive ya Kiingereza hutumika pia katika visa vya 'lest' (marare) na katika maneno kama 'God save the Queen'.

concept_examples.text: It is essential that he be present at the meeting.
concept_examples.translation: Ni lazima kwamba yawe hapa katika mkutano.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪˈsɛnʃəl ðæt hi bi ˈprɛzənt æt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: The doctor recommended that she rest for a few days.
concept_examples.translation: Daktari aliongeza kwamba awe na pumziko siku chache.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɒktə ˌrɛkəˈmɛndɪd ðæt ʃi rɛst fɔːr ə fjuː deɪz/

concept_examples.text: I demand that you be honest with me.
concept_examples.translation: Ninaomba kwamba uwe wa kweli nami.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ dɪˈmɑːnd ðæt juː bi ˈɒnɪst wɪð miː/

concept_examples.text: It is crucial that the data be verified before publication.
concept_examples.translation: Ni jambo la maana kwamba data zifanyiwe uhakiki kabla ya kutoa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈkruːʃəl ðæt ðə ˈdeɪtə bi ˈvɛrɪfaɪd bɪˈfɔː ˌpʌblɪˈkeɪʃən/

common_error.wrong: It is essential that he is present at the meeting.
common_error.correct: It is essential that he be present at the meeting.
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu hii hutokea kwa sababu katika Kiispania, subjunctive ina mfano wake mwenyewe (esté), na wanafunzi hutoa kutumia indicative ya Kiingereza 'is' ambayo inasikilizwa kama ya kawaida. Lakini katika subjunctive rahisi ya Kiingereza, verb lazima iwe katika mfano wa msingi (be) bila ya kubadilisha kwa ajili ya mtu. Ili kuiweka mbali, kumbuka kwamba baada ya maneno ya uhiti au maana, verb katika visa vya 'that' lazima iwe katika mfano wa infinitive, bila ya -s, hata na he/she/it. Jaribu kubadilisha maneno kutoka indicative hadi subjunctive.

levels.label: After adjectives of necessity
levels.translation: Baada ya nyinginezo za uhiti

examples.original: It is important that she attend the conference.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪmˈpɔːtənt ðæt ʃi əˈtɛnd ðə ˈkɒnfərəns/
examples.translation: Ni jambo la maana kwamba awe katika mkutano.
examples.note: Pata kwamba 'attend' hauna -s hata ingawa mtu ni 'she'. Katika Kiispania tunasema 'asista', hivyo usawa ni moja katika maana.

examples.original: It is necessary that every student bring their own laptop.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈnɛsəsəri ðæt ˈɛvri ˈstjuːdənt brɪŋ ðeər oʊn ˈlæptɒp/
examples.translation: Ni lazima kwamba kila mwanafunzi awe na kompyuta yake mwenyewe.
examples.note: Hapa 'student' ni mmoja, lakini 'bring' hauna -s kwa sababu ni subjunctive. Katika Kiispania tunatumia 'traiga'.

examples.original: It is vital that the team communicate clearly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈvaɪtəl ðæt ðə tiːm kəˈmjuːnɪkeɪt ˈklɪəli/
examples.translation: Ni jambo la maana kwamba kundi lichangue mwongozo kwa ujasiri.
examples.note: Verb 'communicate' imewekwa katika mfano wa msingi, hata ingawa mtu 'team' ni mmoja katika Kiispania tunasema 'se comunique'.

levels.label: After verbs of recommendation or demand
levels.translation: Baada ya vitendo vya ushirika au ombi

examples.original: The manager insists that employees use the new software.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmænɪdʒər ɪnˈsɪsts ðæt ˌɛmplɔɪˈiːz juːz ðə njuː ˈsɒftweər/
examples.translation: Meneja anahitaji kwamba wafanyikazi watumie programi mpya.
examples.note: Hapa 'insists' ni verb msingi katika hali ya sasa, lakini katika visa vya subordinada tunatumia 'use' katika mfano wa msingi.

examples.original: They demanded that she apologize immediately.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ dɪˈmɑːnd ðæt ʃi əˈpɒlədʒaɪz ɪˈmiːdiətli/
examples.translation: Walitaka kwamba yeye apate kusamehe mara moja.
examples.note: Pata kwamba hali ya msingi ni zamani ('demanded'), lakini subjunctive bado ni mfano wa msingi 'apologize'. Katika Kiispania tunasema 'se disculpara' (zamani za subjunctive).

examples.original: I suggest that he take a break.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ səˈdʒɛst ðæt hi teɪk ə breɪk/
examples.translation: Ninaona kwamba yeye apate pumziko.
examples.note: Katika Kiispania, 'tome' ni hali ya sasa ya subjunctive; katika Kiingereza, 'take' ni mfano wa msingi.

levels.label: Formal and academic contexts
levels.translation: Mazingira ya rasmi na ya akademiki

examples.original: The committee recommended that the proposal be rejected.
examples.phonetic: /ðə kəˈmɪti ˌrɛkəˈmɛndɪd ðæt ðə prəˈpoʊzəl bi rɪˈdʒɛktɪd/
examples.translation: Kamati iliongeza kwamba takdimu litakase.
examples.note: Katika kesi hii, 'be' ni subjunctive ya verb 'to be'. Sauti ya pasivi 'be rejected' inaendelea na subjunctive.

examples.original: It is essential that the contract be signed by Friday.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪˈsɛnʃəl ðæt ðə ˈkɒntrækt bi saɪnd baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/
examples.translation: Ni jambo la maana kwamba makubaliano yafanyiwe kwa ajili ya Ijumaa.
examples.note: Subjunctive 'be' hutumika badala ya 'is'. Katika Kiispania tunatumia 'sea' (hali ya sasa ya subjunctive).

examples.original: The regulations require that each member be notified in writing.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˌrɛɡjʊˈleɪʃənz rɪˈkwaɪər ðæt iːtʃ ˈmɛmbər bi ˈnoʊtɪfaɪd ɪn ˈraɪtɪŋ/
examples.translation: Kanunizo huhitaji kwamba kila mwanachama apate taarifa kwa yakiti.
examples.note: Katika Kiispania, 'sea notificado' ni subjunctive. Katika Kiingereza, 'be' hutumika kama subjunctive.

title: Future Perfect and Continuous / Sifa na Matumizi ya Sifa ya Kija
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, tunatumia sifa ya kija kuelezea matendo yatayoendelea katika muda ujao, lakini Kiingereza inahitaji mbinu zaidi ya usahihi kuelezea matendo ambayo tayari yatakuwa yamekwisha au yatakuwa yanapoendelea katika muda wa kija. Sifa ya kija ya kwisha (will have + past participle) ina maana kama 'habré + participio' katika Kihispania, lakini uwe makini: katika Kihispania mara nyingi tunatumia sifa ya kija kwa ajili ya matumizi mawili, wakati Kiingereza inahitaji tofauti kati yao. Jambo lingine muhimu ni kwamba sifa ya kija ya kuendelea (will be + -ing) hauna mfano wa karibu katika Kihispania; tunatumia mbinu kama 'estaré haciendo' au tu sifa ya kija, kufuta tofauti ya kuendelea.
rule: Katika Kiingereza, sifa ya kija ya kwisha inundwa na 'will have' + past participle na hutumika kuelezea kwamba kitendo kichakwisha kabla ya muda wa kija. Mfano: 'By 2025, I will have finished my degree.' Sifa ya kija ya kuendelea inundwa na 'will be' + verb in -ing na huonyesha kitendo ambacho kitakuwa kinapoendelea katika muda wa kija. Mfano: 'At 8 p.m., I will be having dinner.' Pia hutumika kuelezea matendo ya kija ambayo yameandikwa au inaweza kutokana, na kuwasiliana kwa heshima kuhusu mipango. Katika vesi vya muda na 'when', 'as soon as', 'until', hutumika sifa ya sasa badala ya sifa ya kija au ya kuendelea: 'When you arrive, I will have cooked dinner.' Sifa ya kija ya kuendelea ya kwisha (will have been + -ing) ni zaidi ya kina na hutumika kuweka uzuri wa muda wa kitendo hadi muda wa kija: 'By June, I will have been living here for six months.' Makosa ya kawaida: kutoka 'will' katika vesi vya muda; kutumia sifa ya kija ya kwisha kwa matendo tu ya kuendelea; na kushambulia past participle na past simple.

concept_examples.text: By next month, I will have finished my project.
concept_examples.translation: Mwezi ujao, nitakuwa nimekwisha chakula yangu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /baɪ nekst mʌnθ aɪ wɪl hæv ˈfɪnɪʃt maɪ ˈprɒdʒekt/

concept_examples.text: At this time tomorrow, we will be flying to London.
concept_examples.translation: Kesho saa hii, tutakuwa tukiongea kwenye barabara ya London.
concept_examples.phonetic: /æt ðɪs taɪm təˈmɒroʊ wi wɪl bi ˈflaɪɪŋ tə ˈlʌndən/

concept_examples.text: She will have been working here for five years by 2026.
concept_examples.translation: Yeye atakuwa amefanya kazi hapa kwa miaka mitano hadi 2026.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl hæv bɪn ˈwɜːrkɪŋ hɪr fɔːr faɪv jɪrz baɪ tuː ˈθaʊzənd ənd ˈtwɛnti sɪks/

concept_examples.text: Don't call me at 7 p.m.; I will be having dinner.
concept_examples.translation: Usinipigie simu saa 7 usiku; nitakuwa nikikiwa chakula.
concept_examples.phonetic: /doʊnt kɔːl mi æt ˈsɛvən pɪˈɛm aɪ wɪl bi ˈhævɪŋ ˈdɪnər/

common_error.wrong: When you will arrive, I will have cooked dinner.
common_error.correct: When you arrive, I will have cooked dinner.
common_error.correct_alt: When you arrive, I will have dinner ready.
common_error.explanation: Katika Kiingereza, baada ya mawasiliano ya muda kama 'when', 'as soon as', 'until', 'before', hutumika sifa ya sasa (si 'will'). Katika Kihispania, mara nyingi tunatumia sifa ya kija katika mbinu hii ('cuando llegarás'), kwa hiyo ni makosa ya kawaida. Kumbuka: katika vesi vya muda, sifa ya sasa; katika vesi vya msingi, sifa ya kija au ya kuendelea.

levels.label: Future Perfect Form & Use
levels.translation: Mbinu na Matumizi ya Sifa ya Kija ya Kwisha

examples.original: I will have left by the time you get here.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl hæv lɛft baɪ ðə taɪm ju gɛt hɪr/
examples.translation: Nitakuwa nimeondoka kabla ya kujikuta.
examples.note: Sifa ya kija ya kwisha huonyesha kitendo kilichokwisha kabla ya muda wa kija. Fikiria kwamba 'by' ni zaidi ya kawaida kuliko 'para'.

examples.original: They will have arrived before noon.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɪl hæv əˈraɪvd bɪfɔːr nuːn/
examples.translation: Wataokuwa wamefika kabla ya adhuhuri.
examples.note: Tunatumia 'before + muda' kuelezea kwamba kitendo kichakwisha kabla ya muda huo.

examples.original: Will you have finished by Friday?
examples.phonetic: /wɪl ju hæv ˈfɪnɪʃt baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/
examples.translation: Utakuwa umekwisha kwa Ijumaa?
examples.note: Swali la kawaida katika mazingira ya kazi kuthibitisha muda.

levels.label: Future Continuous Form & Use
levels.translation: Mbinu na Matumizi ya Sifa ya Kija ya Kuendelea

examples.original: This time next week, I'll be lying on the beach.

examples.translation: Wiki ijayo saa hii, nitakuwa nikiongea kwenye barabara ya ukingo wa bahari.
examples.note: Hutumika kuelezea kitendo ambacho kitakuwa kinapoendelea katika muda wa kija wa kina.

examples.original: We'll be having a meeting at 10 a.m., so don't come early.
examples.phonetic: /wiːl bi ˈhævɪŋ ə ˈmiːtɪŋ æt tɛn eɪ ɛm soʊ doʊnt kʌm ˈɜːrli/
examples.translation: Tutakuwa tukiongea kwenye mikusanyiko ya 10 asubuhi, kwa hiyo usije mapema.
examples.note: Pia hutumika kwa matendo yaliyotengenezwa tayari yatakuwa yanatumika muda wa kija.

examples.original: Will you be using the car tonight?
examples.phonetic: /wɪl ju bi ˈjuːzɪŋ ðə kɑːr təˈnaɪt/
examples.translation: Utakuwa ukitumia gari usiku?
examples.note: Mbinu huu ni zaidi ya heshima kuliko 'will you use' kuwasiliana kuhusu mipango.

levels.label: Future Perfect Continuous
levels.translation: Sifa ya Kija ya Kuendelea ya Kwisha

examples.original: By October, I will have been teaching for ten years.
examples.phonetic: /baɪ ɒkˈtoʊbər aɪ wɪl hæv bɪn ˈtiːtʃɪŋ fɔːr tɛn jɪrz/
examples.translation: Kwa Oktoba, nitakuwa nimefanya kazi kwa miaka kumi.
examples.note: Hutumika kuweka uzuri wa muda wa kitendo ambacho kinachokwenda hadi muda wa kija. Hautumiki na hali kama 'know' au 'like'.

examples.original: He'll be tired because he will have been running all morning.
examples.phonetic: /hiːl bi ˈtaɪərd bɪˈkɒz hi wɪl hæv bɪn ˈrʌnɪŋ ɔːl ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
examples.translation: Yeye atakuwa amechoka kwa sababu atakuwa amefanya kazi asubuhi yote.
examples.note: Mara nyingi tunatumia mbinu huu kuelezea sababu ya kina ya hali ya kija.

examples.original: How long will you have been studying English by then?

examples.translation: Muda gani utakuwa umefanya kazi ya Kiingereza hadi wakati huo?
examples.note: Katika maswali, hutumika kuwasiliana kuhusu muda wa kusanywa katika muda wa kija.

title: Discourse Markers for Cohesion / Ishara za Utangulizi kwa Ujungiamini
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, ishara za utangulizi (kama vile 'however', 'therefore', 'on the other hand') huwa hakiwa katika sehemu ya mwanzo au kati ya koma na mara nyingi hutumika kwa kina. Katika Kiingereza, ishara hizi mengi huhitaji sehemu ya kipekee katika jamlazi na zina maana na utaratibu ambao hawana kawaida kuwa na ufanano. Kwa mfano, 'however' (lakini) inaweza kuwa katika mwanzo, katikati au mwisho na ishara tofauti za kusambaza, wakati 'although' (ingawa) huwa huanza jamlazi la kinafiki na haikubali koma moja tu. Jikinge na kutafsiri haraka 'therefore' (hivyo) na 'so' (hivyo): 'so' ni zaidi ya kawaida na hutumika katika mazungumzo, wakati 'therefore' ni rasmi na ya kutungwa.
rule: Ishara za utangulizi katika Kiingereza (B2) zimegawanywa katika jamii tofauti: za kuongeza (furthermore, moreover, in addition), za kubainisha (however, nevertheless, on the other hand, whereas), za sababu/athari (therefore, consequently, as a result, thus), za utaratibu (firstly, secondly, finally, meanwhile), na za kubadilisha (in other words, that is to say). Kanuni muhimu: 1) 'However' hutumika kama jina na hutoa na koma; inaweza kuwa katika mwanzo, katikati au mwisho. Mfano: 'The weather was bad. However, we went out.' / 'The weather was bad. We went out, however.' 2) 'Although' ni jina ambalo huanza jamlazi la kinafiki; hauna koma kama ina kuwa katika mwanzo, lakini hutumika koma kama jamlazi la kinafiki linapo kuwa kwanza: 'Although it was raining, we went out' (hakuna koma baada ya 'although'). 3) 'Therefore' na 'consequently' ni rasmi, hutumika katika andiko za kiuchumi; 'so' ni ya kawaida na hutumika katika mazungumzo. 4) 'On the other hand' hutumika kubaainisha mawazo mawili, lakini si sawa na 'however' (ambayo hubaainisha na yaliyomo kabla). 5) Katika Kiingereza, ishara za kusambaza ni muhimu: jamlazi mbili isiyojulikana zilizoungwa na 'however' huhitaji kipikipiku na koma au kipikipiku, si koma (hitilafu wa kawaida: 'It was raining, however, we went out' → si sahihi, inapaswa kuwa 'It was raining; however, we went out'). 6) Ishara za utaratibu ('firstly', 'secondly', 'finally') huwa hufuatwa na koma na ni ya kawaida katika andiko rasmi. Kumbuka kwamba katika Kispanishi mara nyingi hutumia koma ambapo katika Kiingereza huhitaji kipikipiku au kipikipiku na koma.

concept_examples.text: The company expanded rapidly; however, it failed to maintain quality.
concept_examples.translation: Kampuni hiyo likakuwa na uongezaji wa kasi; lakini, hakujikinga ubora.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌmpəni ɪkˈspændɪd ˈræpɪdli; haʊˈɛvər, ɪt feɪld tə meɪnˈteɪn ˈkwɒləti/

concept_examples.text: Although he was tired, he finished the report on time.
concept_examples.translation: Ingawa alikuwa amechoka, alimaliza ripoti wakati.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɔːlˈðoʊ hi wʌz ˈtaɪərd, hi ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə rɪˈpɔːrt ɒn taɪm/

concept_examples.text: The results were surprising; consequently, the team decided to review the data.
concept_examples.translation: Matokeo yalikuwa ya kushangaza; kama matokeo, kundi lilichagua kufanya taarifa jipya.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈzʌlts wɜːr sərˈpraɪzɪŋ; ˈkɒnsɪkwəntli, ðə tiːm dɪˈsaɪdɪd tə rɪˈvjuː ðə ˈdeɪtə/

concept_examples.text: Firstly, we need to analyze the market. Secondly, we can develop a strategy.
concept_examples.translation: Kwanza, tunahitaji kuchunguza masoko. Pia, tunaweza kuunda mikakati.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈfɜːrstli, wi niːd tə ˈænəlaɪz ðə ˈmɑːrkɪt. ˈsɛkəndli, wi kæn dɪˈvɛləp ə ˈstrætədʒi/

common_error.wrong: It was raining, however, we went to the beach.
common_error.correct: It was raining; however, we went to the beach.
common_error.correct_alt: It was raining. However, we went to the beach.
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu huu huonekana kwa sababu katika Kispanishi ni kawaida kutumia koma kuwashirikisha vituo, kama katika 'Ilikuwa inarisha, lakini, tulikwenda kwenye kivumbi'. Lakini katika Kiingereza, 'however' si jina, bali ni jina la kushirikiana, na haikubali kuwashirikisha vituo mbili isiyojulikana na koma moja tu. Unapaswa kutumia kipikipiku (;) au kipikipiku (.) kabla ya 'however'. Jifunze tofauti kati ya 'however' (kubainisha) na 'although' (kufanya upatanisho): 'Although it was raining, we went' ni sahihi, lakini huwezi kusema 'Although it was raining, however, we went' (inaongezeka).

levels.label: Contrast Markers
levels.translation: Ishara za Kubainisha

examples.original: She is very talented; nevertheless, she lacks experience.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪz ˈvɛri ˈtæləntɪd; ˌnɛvərðəˈlɛs, ʃiː læks ɪkˈspɪəriəns/
examples.translation: Yeye ni wenye ujuzi mkubwa; lakini, hana uzoefu.
examples.note: 'Nevertheless' ni zaidi ya rasmi kuliko 'but' na hutumika katika mazingira ya kusambaza au rasmi. Katika Kispanishi, mara nyingi hutafsiriwa kama 'lakini'.

examples.original: He prefers tea, whereas his wife drinks coffee.
examples.phonetic: /hiː prɪˈfɜːrz tiː, ˌwɛrˈæz hɪz waɪf drɪŋks ˈkɒfi/
examples.translation: Yeye anapenda chai, wakati mke wake hupoa kahawa.
examples.note: 'Whereas' hutumika kubaainisha mawazo mawili, tofauti na 'however' ambayo hubaainisha na yaliyomo kabla.

examples.original: On the other hand, moving to a new city can be exciting.
examples.phonetic: /ɒn ði ˈʌðər hænd, ˈmuːvɪŋ tə ə nuː ˈsɪti kæn biː ɪkˈsaɪtɪŋ/
examples.translation: Pande zingine, kuhamia mjini mpya inaweza kuwa na furaha.
examples.note: Hutumika kuweka mwangaza wa mawazo tofauti, si tu kubaainisha bali pia kuweka mwangaza.

levels.label: Cause and Effect Markers
levels.translation: Ishara za Sababu na Athari

examples.original: The flight was delayed; as a result, we missed the connection.
examples.phonetic: /ðə flaɪt wʌz dɪˈleɪd; æz ə rɪˈzʌlt, wi mɪst ðə kəˈnɛkʃən/
examples.translation: Ndege ilipitisha; kama matokeo, tulipotea mbio.
examples.note: 'As a result' ni laini ambalo hutumika mara nyingi katika mwanzo wa vituo vya pili. Angalia kipikipiku.

examples.original: He didn't study; thus, he failed the exam.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ˈdɪdnt ˈstʌdi; ðʌs, hiː feɪld ði ɪɡˈzæm/
examples.translation: Hakustudi; hivyo, alishindwa katika imtihani.
examples.note: 'Thus' ni zaidi ya rasmi na hutumika katika Kiingereza ya kiuchumi. Katika mazungumzo tunatumia 'so'.

examples.original: The new policy was unpopular. Consequently, many employees resigned.
examples.phonetic: /ðə nuː ˈpɒləsi wʌz ʌnˈpɒpjʊlər. ˈkɒnsɪkwəntli, ˈmɛni ɪmˈplɔɪiːz rɪˈzaɪnd/
examples.translation: Siasa mpya ilikuwa isipatikana. Kama matokeo, wafanyakazi wengi waliondoka.
examples.note: Wakati inapo kuwa katika mwanzo wa jamlazi isiyojulikana, 'consequently' huwa hufuatwa na koma.

levels.label: Sequencing and Reformulation Markers
levels.translation: Ishara za Utaratibu na Kubadilisha

examples.original: First, preheat the oven. Then, mix the ingredients.
examples.phonetic: /fɜːrst, ˌpriːˈhiːt ði ˈʌvən. ðɛn, mɪks ði ɪnˈɡriːdiənts/
examples.translation: Kwanza, washa jiko. Baadaye, changanyisha vipande.
examples.note: Katika Kiingereza, 'first' na 'then' ni zaidi ya kawaida kuliko 'firstly' na 'secondly', ambayo ni zaidi ya rasmi.

examples.original: In other words, the project was a complete failure.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn ˈʌðər wɜːrdz, ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt wʌz ə kəmˈpliːt ˈfeɪljər/
examples.translation: Kwa maneno mengine, mradi ulikuwa uharibifu kwa ujumla.
examples.note: Hutumika kubadilisha au kuelezea jambo kwa njia inayofahamu zaidi.

examples.original: Finally, we reached an agreement after hours of negotiation.
examples.phonetic: /ˈfaɪnəli, wi riːtʃt æn əˈɡriːmənt ˈæftər ˈaʊərz ɒv nɪˌɡəʊʃiˈeɪʃən/
examples.translation: Mwishowe, tulifikia makubaliano baada ya masaa ya mazungumzo.
examples.note: 'Finally' inaweza maana 'mwishowe' (furaha) au 'katika sehemu ya mwisho' (utaratibu). Mazingira ndiyo inayothibitisha.

title: Hedging Language / Lugha ya Kubalancea
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, tunatumia vitendo vya kiwango, vitenzi vya kiwango na maneno maalum ya kuweka ujumbe katika njia ya kuweka ujumbe. Kuna makosa ya kawaida kama kutafsiri 'niagiza kuwa' kama 'tend to' bila kutumia tendeo sahihi, au kutumia 'apparently' badala ya 'seemingly'. Hapa utaona jinsi ya kuweka maoni yako kama mtu anayezungumza asili, kukiwa kuwa mtu anayezungumza kwa kiwango cha kutosha.
rule: Hedging katika Kiingereza hutumika kuwakilisha uwahasibu, utajiri au ujumbe mkubwa. Hutoa: 1) Vitendo vya kiwango: may, might, could, can. Mifano: 'It might rain' (Inaweza kushua). 2) Vitenzi vya kiwango au shaka: usually, generally, apparently, presumably. Mifano: 'Apparently, he left early' (Kwa kiwango, aliondoka mapema). 3) Vitendo vya maoni ya kiwango: I think, I believe, I suppose, I tend to think. Mifano: 'I tend to agree with you' (Niagiza kuwa na ujumbe nawe). 4) Maneno ya kiwango: It seems that, It appears that, It is said that. Mifano: 'It seems that she is tired' (Inaonekana kwamba yupo na utajiri). 5) Mihumo ya 'tend to' + infinitive kwa ajili ya tabia au utendaji. Mifano: 'He tends to arrive late' (Kwa kawaida huja mapema). 6) 'Apparently' hutumika kwa ajili ya ujumbe ambao unajua kutoka kwenye vyombo vya habari, wakati 'seemingly' hutumika kwa ajili ya utaratibu. 7) 'Rather' na 'quite' wanaweza kuweka ujumbe katika ajili ya maneno ya kiwango. Mifano: 'It's rather expensive' (Ni ghali zaidi). 8) Katika mazingira ya masomo, inapendekezwa kutumia 'would seem' au 'could be argued' kwa ajili ya kiwango cha kutosha. Kumbuka kwamba katika Kiingereza tunatumia kiwango cha kutosha baada ya 'it seems that', lakini katika Kiingereza hutumika kiwango cha kutosha: 'It seems that he is sick' (Inaonekana kwamba yupo na ugonjwa).

concept_examples.text: I tend to think that the project is feasible.
concept_examples.translation: Niagiza kuwa na ujumbe kwamba mradi ni wenye kutoa faida.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ tɛnd tuː θɪŋk ðæt ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt ɪz ˈfiːzəbəl/

concept_examples.text: It seems that the meeting has been rescheduled.
concept_examples.translation: Inaonekana kwamba mikusanyiko imebadilishwa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt siːmz ðæt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ hæz biːn riːˈʃɛdjʊld/

concept_examples.text: Apparently, the company is planning a merger.
concept_examples.translation: Kwa kiwango, kampuni inaongea kuhusu uungwana.
concept_examples.phonetic: /əˈpærəntli ðə ˈkʌmpəni ɪz ˈplænɪŋ ə ˈmɜːdʒər/

concept_examples.text: He may be late, but I'm not sure.
concept_examples.translation: Inaweza kuja mapema, lakini sina uhakika.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː meɪ biː leɪt bʌt aɪm nɒt ʃʊr/

common_error.wrong: I think that the project is feasible.
common_error.correct: I tend to think that the project is feasible.
common_error.correct_alt: It seems to me that the project is feasible.
common_error.explanation: Katika Kiingereza, 'I think' hutumika kwa kiwango, lakini katika Kiingereza 'I think' inaweza kuwa na ujumbe mkubwa katika mazingira ya masomo au wakati unapotaka kuweka ujumbe. Makosa huo huonekana kwa sababu ya kutafsiri moja kwa moja kutoka Kiingereza. Ili kutumia hedging, unaweza kutumia 'I tend to think', 'I would say', au 'I suppose' ili kuweka ujumbe. Ihaya kutumia 'I think' kwa kiwango cha kutosha ukitaka ujumbe wa kiwango au wa masomo.

levels.label: Adverbs of Uncertainty
levels.translation: Vitenzi vya utajiri

examples.original: Apparently, the flight has been delayed.
examples.phonetic: /əˈpærəntli ðə flaɪt hæz biːn dɪˈleɪd/
examples.translation: Kwa kiwango, ndege umepotea.
examples.note: Hutumika 'apparently' wakati ujumbe unatoka kwenye vyombo vya habari, si kutoka kwenye uzoefu mbalimbali.

examples.original: Presumably, he has already finished the report.
examples.phonetic: /prɪˈzjuːməbli hiː hæz ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə rɪˈpɔːt/
examples.translation: Kwa kiwango, taarifa imekwisha.
examples.note: 'Presumably' huonesha ujumbe ambao ni wa kiwango, kama 'probablemente' katika Kiingereza.

examples.original: Generally, people prefer to work in the morning.
examples.phonetic: /ˈdʒɛnərəli ˈpiːpəl prɪˈfɜːr tuː wɜːk ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/
examples.translation: Kwa kawaida, watu wanapenda kufanya kazi asubuhi.
examples.note: 'Generally' huonesha utendaji mkubwa, lakini si sheria isiyo na mbadala.

levels.label: Modal Verbs for Hedging
levels.translation: Vitendo vya kiwango kwa ajili ya kubalancea

examples.original: It might rain later, so take an umbrella.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt maɪt reɪn ˈleɪtər soʊ teɪk ən ʌmˈbrɛlə/
examples.translation: Inaweza kushua baadaye, kwa hiyo chukua mvua.
examples.note: 'Might' huonesha ujumbe wa kiwango kuliko 'may'. Katika Kiingereza hutafsiriwa kama 'puede que'.

examples.original: Could you help me with this problem?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː hɛlp miː wɪð ðɪs ˈprɒbləm/
examples.translation: Unaweza kusaidia katika jambo hili?
examples.note: 'Could' huonesha ombi kwa kiwango, kuweka ujumbe kuliko 'can'.

examples.original: This could be the best option for us.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs kʊd biː ðə bɛst ˈɒpʃən fɔːr ʌs/
examples.translation: Hii inaweza kuwa chaguo bora zaidi kwa ajili yetu.
examples.note: Hutumika 'could' ili kutoa ujumbe bila kutoa ahadi.

levels.label: Impersonal Structures and Tendencies
levels.translation: Mihumo ya kiwango na utendaji

examples.original: It seems that the prices have increased significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt siːmz ðæt ðə ˈpraɪsɪz hæv ˈɪnkriːst sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Inaonekana kwamba bei zimeongezeka kwa kiwango.
examples.note: 'It seems that' + kiwango cha kutosha, tofauti na kiwango cha kutosha katika Kiingereza.

examples.original: I tend to agree with the new policy.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ tɛnd tuː əˈɡriː wɪð ðə njuː ˈpɒləsi/
examples.translation: Niagiza kuwa na ujumbe nawe katika sera jipya.
examples.note: 'Tend to' huonesha utendaji au tabia, sawa na 'soler' katika Kiingereza.

examples.original: She appears to be very confident.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː əˈpɪərz tuː biː ˈvɛri ˈkɒnfɪdənt/
examples.translation: Inaonekana kwamba yupo na ujasiri mkubwa.
examples.note: 'Appears to' hutumika kwa ajili ya ujumbe ambao unapoonekana, kama 'parece' katika Kiingereza.
